assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only my-hero-academia:sir-nighteye@manga#reviewed-dedicated-analysis, the canonical V2 character reconstruction model MHA_SP2_SIR_NIGHTEYE_CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the Japanese main manga V01-V42 with the source-labeled Ultra Archive, Ultra Analysis and Ultra Age claims its SN-SUP-01 to SN-SUP-03 sections admit. The MHA character modeling schema and the current-state corpus map were consulted for method and boundary only; the readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit, aggregate validation report and the V14, V15, V17 and V18 deep readings are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them. The model's strong readiness label and its retrospective holdout probe are inputs, not conclusions. No original manga page, anime adaptation, V1 material or other character's model is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Living states from Sir Nighteye's V14 office evaluation of Midoriya (V14:p164-196) through the V15 Foresight doctrine, the V17 long-range fatal forecast and the V18 revision and death at V18:p077, kept as separable snapshots (pre-contradiction evaluator and fearful forecaster through V17; terminal reviser at V18). Later Mirio and All Might material is legacy evidence and the posthumous remembered prediction is not a living state; no post-V18 actor state exists or is established by this evidence set.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states a motivational hierarchy (reliable professional judgment, preventing catastrophic loss, protecting the hero future embodied by All Might and Mirio, a society with energy and humor), a feared self (a witness whose information cannot avert, or might fix, a loved person's death), an ideal self as an exacting, useful evaluator, and a decision policy (demand usable evidence, separate knowable from hindsight, use Foresight only with a decision role, revise when reality defeats the model). Each rests on five located atoms SN01-SN05 (V14, V15, V17, V18) with high confidence. Not B: five atoms in one compact secondary artifact, one retrospective probe, and ordinary life outside work, fandom and mentorship is stated to be below specialist breadth. Not D: the policy is operational and yields located conditional predictions.

Three coarse snapshots are separated: the V14-V15 evaluator, the V17 fearful forecaster shaped by recalled failed attempts (SN04), and the V18 terminal reviser (SN05). The model forbids blending V15 refusal and V18 openness into a timeless trait and forbids projecting deathbed speech backward. Not C: development is observed across roughly five volumes and ends in death; the model says death prevents observing stable practice after the update, and the history with All Might is recalled rather than staged.

Attested register features are few: 私, formal distance, exact directives and evaluative vocabulary in office and command contexts, and direct おまえ with an instruction to keep smiling toward terminal Mirio (V18:p075-076). The model rates speech confidence strongest for work, All Might and Mirio and calls private unrelated relationships speculative. These answer bounded canon questions about address and register only; the discovery row does not enroll SPEECH for this subject.

Ordinary texture is limited to intense All Might fandom, preserved memorabilia, humor standards in the office (SN01-SN02) and the supplement-attested merchandise and tickling-machine punishment gag (SN-SUP-01). The model states that ordinary life outside work, fandom and mentorship remains below specialist breadth and that independent nonprofessional life remains thin.

A five-row partner table (All Might, Midoriya, Mirio, staff and trainees, other professionals) gives a one-sentence conditional difference for each. All Might, Midoriya and Mirio are tied to located atoms (SN01, SN02, SN05) and a distinct terminal register toward Mirio is recorded. Not C: the staff and professional rows are categorical, per-partner deltas are sketched rather than worked, and the Mirio and All Might deathbed states are exceptional stress states the model forbids generalizing.

Fear of fixing a path by viewing it, dread shaped by recalled failed attempts (SN04), emotional dependence on All Might and Mirio, and regulation through formal distance, precision and humor are inferred from behavior and his own recollection. The model marks his observer-effect belief as a hypothesis, the mechanism of the changed future as open and the content of the final Mirio vision as open, and treats the supplement's sacrificial-motive question as unestablished (SN-SUP-03). Substantial inference without a demonstrated interior model.

Located conflict covers professional disagreement over succession without personal hatred (SN01), conflict with All Might over a foreseen death (SN02), defending interns from blame and a restrictive knowledge policy that Fat Gum contests (SN03), and short tactical Foresight use in combat before a forced fatal forecast (SN04). Not C: each mode rests on one or two scenes, and combat behavior is summarized rather than modeled as a policy.

The model supplies an explicit normative doctrine: protect people from retrospective blame for unavailable information; investigate and raise success probability before using Foresight; knowing more is not better when the knowledge is unbearable and no intervention route exists (SN03). It derives located predictions (a V15 request to scan a colleague's death with no actionable plan yields refusal or a demand for prior investigation at high confidence; a narrowed lead to secure a child makes use more likely) and keeps the doctrine contestable against Fat Gum's challenge. Not B: one domain (knowledge and Foresight use) and one stated doctrine; the discovery row does not enroll ETHICS.

Humor is recorded as a serious value with severe humor judgments, an unusual office humor culture and the tickling-machine gag (SN01-SN02, SN-SUP-01). No humor repertoire or enacted joke is modeled, and the model warns that the gag lacks established employee consent and does not require imitation in a novel workplace.

The project's analytical corpus is complete for V01-V42 and the three admitted supplements, and Sir Nighteye's living canon falls within V14-V18, which the five atoms span with page locators. Only the V18 decisive pages are stated to be directly checked; the model does not itemize every appearance, and its supplements are profile and editorial claims rather than enacted scenes.

Affirmative limits are located: V18:p038 admits the actual future differed and he does not know why; the model REVISEs fatal certainty, REJECTs anti-Midoriya caricature, all-seeing information and V42 living behavior, keeps Foresight's activation, interval and target-centered limits, and records the probe's speech and emotional-trajectory axes as only partial. The supplement's workplace gag lacks established consent and the sacrificial motive stays uncertain. Not B: the limits rest on a few windows inside one artifact.

The terminal boundary is fixed at V18:p077, snapshots are named by volume and page, deathbed speech may not be projected backward, the V15 and V18 policies may not be blended, and the posthumous remembered prediction is not a living return. In-world dates are not given, and the rule selects a story period rather than fine chronology.

scenario_readiness.note: The model states that generated dialogue would be an illustrative prediction, never an attributed quotation, and its attested register is a handful of forms in office and terminal contexts; the probe rates speech and register only partial. Lines beyond those forms would be fluent invention rather than source-supported voice. This bounds the evidence set, not Sir Nighteye's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named snapshot: the V14-V17 evaluator and forecaster, or the V18 terminal reviser; the two are never blended and no post-V18 state is used.
The situation is a professional evaluation, investigation or Foresight-use decision where the model's decision policy applies.
The interlocutor is All Might, Midoriya, Mirio, office staff or trainees, or another professional handled in the categorical mode the partner table gives, with no invented private relationship.

Output is a behavioral description separating high-confidence behavior, plausible alternatives and flip conditions, as the MHA schema's output contract requires, and abstains on the model's OPEN items: the mechanism of changed prediction, the final Mirio vision and what a surviving Nighteye would have revised next.
No quoted dialogue is produced as canon, and no readiness is inherited from the project's strong label or its retrospective probe.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: Pre-contradiction Sir Nighteye between the V14 office evaluation and the V17 fatal forecast, or the V18 terminal state after the observed contradiction, named explicitly.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: All Might as revered former partner in professional disagreement, Midoriya as a skeptically evaluated trainee, Mirio as a valued successor and protege, office staff or trainees, or another professional in categorical mode.
setting_constraints: Hero office, internship, investigation or command situation
A decision about evaluation, disclosure or Foresight use is at issue
Foresight keeps its activation, interval and target-centered limits
No ordinary private-life, romance or postmortem setting

scenario_readiness.note: The model's decision policy and two located conditional predictions support narrow novel decisions about evaluation and Foresight use. Its one formal probe is a retrospective, nonblind chronological holdout with partial speech and emotional axes, and no post-V18 future exists to test, so readiness is conditional and narrow.

The model affirmatively states that ordinary life outside work, fandom and mentorship remains below specialist breadth and that independent nonprofessional life remains thin; fandom, humor standards and one supplemental gag are the only ordinary texture.

conditions: The dilemma concerns knowledge, disclosure, blame for unavailable information or whether to use Foresight, within one named snapshot.
The V15 doctrine and the V18 revision are kept separate, and the doctrine is presented as his contestable position, not the manga's endorsed rule.
Abstain on ethics outside that domain, such as private obligations, romance or political questions the model does not address.
scenario_readiness.note: A located doctrine about knowledge, blame and Foresight use supports bounded deliberation in that domain only.
Nothing in the evidence set establishes romantic conduct or its absence. This gap says nothing about the character.

conditions: Hero-office, internship or investigative work only, within a named snapshot no later than V18.
Foresight keeps its activation conditions, roughly daily interval and target-centered limited view; it never supplies omniscient maps or others' motives.
Evaluation separates outcome, indirect evidence and permissions as SN01 shows, and disagreement is not rendered as personal hatred.
scenario_readiness.note: His best-evidenced domain is professional evaluation, mentorship and Foresight-assisted investigation, located across SN01-SN05.

known_limits.statement: The model ends with death at V18:p077; later Mirio and All Might behavior is legacy evidence, the posthumous remembered prediction is not a living return, and no canonical future exists to show how a surviving Nighteye would practice after revising his account.
Ordinary life outside work, fandom and mentorship remains below specialist breadth, and independent nonprofessional life remains thin.

That a forecast differed is firmer than why it differed: his conjecture that many people's energy converged on Midoriya is his explanation, not established causal law, and his belief that viewing may fix a path is a hypothesis, not a demonstrated law.

Supplement profile facts and editorial framing constrain reconstruction without becoming enacted manga observations: the workplace punishment gag lacks established consent, the deathbed disclosure of no resentment does not show he never felt hurt, and the sacrificial motive question is not established motive.

The single formal probe SN-V01 is a retrospective chronological evidence holdout by an analyst who had read later manga, not a blind experiment; supported axes are qualitative comparisons and the speech and emotional-trajectory axes are only partial.

The deep readings, readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit and aggregate validation report linked from the model are not curated evidence on this subject, so their warrants were not independently rechecked here. Anime performance and any supplement material beyond what the model cites lie outside this evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
